source.purpose: Manual Phase 2 entity and relationship additions layered over the legacy inductee adapter.

reviewGuidance.entities: Add manually curated Community, Organization, Place, and Event entities here. Person, Theme, Event class-year, and Media entities are generated from the existing inductee pipeline.
reviewGuidance.relationships: Every relationship must reference existing entity ids from public/data/entities.json or curated entities in this file.
reviewGuidance.provenance: Use documented only with a reviewed source note. Use curated for curator-approved assertions. Use inferred for suggestions needing review.
